overview.text: Today's developments span infrastructure shifts, verification advances, and new evaluation frameworks that matter for technical practitioners. On the infrastructure side, discussions highlight AMD-specific forks of llama.cpp alongside a resurgence in self-hosting interest and signs that OpenAI may be entering cost control mode. In formal methods and verification, Anthropic released a much shorter version of GRH Lean verification. Meanwhile, researchers introduced Puzzling-Bench to evaluate language models on thousands of human-written puzzles with community-verified answers from the Puzzling Stack Exchange archive. Additional releases include new multi-agent training guides and specialized tools like inworld/voice-isolator and sand-ai/MAGI-2-preview, offering founders and researchers fresh benchmarks and technical resources to navigate current compute and deployment constraints.

entries.title: Puzzling-Bench: Evaluating Language Models on 23,777 Human-Written Puzzles with Community-Verified Answers
entries.summary: We introduce Puzzling-Bench, a benchmark of 23,777 puzzles with community-verified answers drawn from the Puzzling Stack Exchange archive (2014-2026): riddles, ciphers, logic grids, lateral-thinking problems, wordplay and recreational mathematics, a third of them with images.…
entries.why: Puzzling-Bench tests language models on complex human puzzles with community-verified answers.

entries.title: Demystifying the Autoresearch Harness: How Context and Skills Shape Self-Evolving Agents
entries.summary: Autoresearch agents, which autonomously design, run, and refine experiments, are accelerating scientific progress, particularly in AI research.
entries.why: Autoresearch harnesses demonstrate autonomous experiment design accelerating AI research progress.

entries.title: Lost in Translation, Not in Confidence: Benchmarking and Calibrating Multilingual Decision Models
entries.summary: Decision models are language models fine-tuned to return a probability for each option of a typed query, which routers and guardrails threshold directly. They are built on multilingual bases but ranked almost entirely in English.
entries.why: Multilingual decision models address calibration gaps in routed router and guardrail systems.

entries.why: Pure assembly implementations offer extreme optimization insights for bare-metal machine learning.
